# patternfly

Everything you need for PatternFly development -- React components, design guidance, migration, and MCP docs. Installs all PatternFly sub-plugins in one step.

!!! info "Plugin Details"

    - **Version**: 0.1.0
    - **Author**: UXD Team
    - **License**: MIT
    - **Scope**: Generic
    - **Category**: [Development Tools](../../categories/development-tools.md)

## Includes

Installing this plugin installs the following plugins:

- [`pf-react`](../pf-react/index.md)
- [`pf-design-guide`](../pf-design-guide/index.md)

- [`pf-migration`](../pf-migration/index.md)
